description: Complete an outpost or civic centre inside the eastern target region and hold it for 300 turns before turn 2400.

objective.success: A completed outpost or civic centre owned by player 1 lies inside the region at every boundary of a 300-turn window ending by turn 2400.
objective.public: Expand east: complete an outpost (or a civic centre) whose position lies inside x in [352, 448) and z in [208, 304), and keep it for 300 turns. The region is outside your territory; outposts may be built in neutral territory.
